Game Overview

In Ole Bunny, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a whimsical adventure with Ole Bunny, where a lovable rabbit dodges wild bulls in pursuit of roses. Navigate thrilling arenas, showcasing agility and wit to gather blooms while evading danger. Prove your mettle and become the ultimate bunny matador in this charming, action-packed escapade!
